title: Mark Zuckerberg says Muse has drawn 10M+ users since its launch and 25%+ of users are making purchases through the app, with an average purchase size of $200+ (Business Insider)
summary: Business Insider: Mark Zuckerberg says Muse has drawn 10M+ users since its launch and 25%+ of users are making purchases through the app, with an average purchase size of $200+ — - Meta reported third-quarter earnings on Wednesday. — Meta CEO Mark Zuckerberg said over 10 million people have set up a Muse AI agent since its launch.
